resources.string: Scoring SVS-1.0: reference device = 10,000. Item = 1000 × clamp(measured/reference, 0.2, 5.0); category = weighted geometric mean; overall = CPU 30% / GPU 35% / Memory 20% / AppIO 15%.
Full suite 15 items: CPU×5, memory×3 (incl. latency curve), storage×4, GPU×3 (Vulkan Compute).
Reference pack SV-REF-2026-08-A frozen (8 runs on the reference device); item = 1000 × clamp(measured/reference, 0.2, 5.0); RETEST/INVALID items excluded from scoring.
Measurement: adaptive 5/7/11 rounds after warmup convergence, median reported. CV ≤ 3% STABLE, ≤ 7% VARIABLE, > 7% RETEST_RECOMMENDED; failed correctness check is INVALID.
